themes.name: Geometric Twenty-Four
themes.description: Dark geometric prism lock screen with cyan and pink indicators, a compact word clock, and a live date header.

themes.name: Purple Anime Stack Clock
themes.description: Vivid purple stacked-outline clock with a vertical date rail and lower anime-inspired artwork; no music-player panel.

themes.name: Animated Psychedelic Cat
themes.description: Animated geometric cat lock screen with live date and time; no notification, notch, or status-bar markup.

themes.name: Comic Graffiti Wall Clock
themes.description: Monochrome comic-graffiti collage with a darkened wallpaper, one large Sour Gummy live clock, and a small live date; no notifications, notch, or status-bar overlay.

themes.name: The Silent Hour
themes.description: Charlie Chaplin-inspired silent-film newspaper lock screen with the original monochrome street wallpaper, live time/date, Walsall weather label, and battery status.

themes.name: Animated Art Gallery
themes.description: White gilt-framed animated art gallery with an elegant bottom label.

themes.name: Pulse Timeline
themes.description: A looping ECG trace that draws the live time without ordinary clock text.

themes.name: Brushstroke Time
themes.description: A realistic brush paints the live time, then a rotating small historical painting study.

themes.name: Native Test Lock
themes.description: A local UIKit/Core Animation test lock with no HTML, JavaScript, remote resources, or external navigation.
